description: CREATE / DROP / ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW: SHOW MATERIALIZED VIEWS listing and text cell, DROP with and without IF EXISTS, SUSPEND / RESUME / REFRESH accepted (their suspended-flag effect has no SQL read surface - SHOW carries no such cell, live-verified - so the Java class's embedded-internal flag asserts are represented here as statement acceptance), COMMENT before AS, and ALTER SET COMMENT. Converted from ddl/CreateMaterializedViewTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, username VARCHAR)
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_users AS SELECT * FROM users
SHOW MATERIALIZED VIEWS LIKE 'mv_users'
CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, price INTEGER)
INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 'Widget', 100), (2, 'Gadget', 200)
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_expensive AS SELECT * FROM products WHERE price > 150
SHOW MATERIALIZED VIEWS LIKE 'mv_expensive'
SELECT CONTAINS(LOWER("text"), 'price > 150') FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE items (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_items AS SELECT * FROM items
SHOW MATERIALIZED VIEWS LIKE 'mv_items'
DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_items
SHOW MATERIALIZED VIEWS LIKE 'mv_items'
DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS nonexistent_mv
CREATE TABLE data (id INTEGER, value VARCHAR)
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_data AS SELECT * FROM data
ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_data SUSPEND
CREATE TABLE data (id INTEGER, value VARCHAR)
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_data AS SELECT * FROM data
ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_data SUSPEND
ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_data RESUME
CREATE TABLE data (id INTEGER, value VARCHAR)
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_data AS SELECT * FROM data
ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_data REFRESH
CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER, amount INTEGER)
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_sales COMMENT = 'Sales data' AS SELECT * FROM sales
SHOW MATERIALIZED VIEWS LIKE 'mv_sales'
SELECT "comment" FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER, total INTEGER)
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_orders AS SELECT * FROM orders
ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_orders SET COMMENT = 'Order summary'
SHOW MATERIALIZED VIEWS LIKE 'mv_orders'
SELECT "comment" FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
